evidence.read: Stocks in play yesterday (top fifth) had big moves 30% of sessions, against 19% for the universe. After strong days the next day continued 44% of the time, so the side is decided at the open unless a lean is shown.

plan.rule: Wait for the first 15 minutes. Long on a break above the opening-range high, stop at the opening-range low; short on a break below the low, stop at the high. Targets: 1x and 2x the opening range from the trigger.
